note: Testbird HITL recipe (SYS_HITL 1). Expected parameters = firmware defaults + airframe + boot + verify_only + set (docs/recipes.md). The airframe section is what PX4's airframe 2100 and rc.fw_defaults set (param set-default); the boot section is filled from the first readback of a flashed board (not yet).

CA_ROTOR_COUNT.why: control allocation and HIL outputs as in PX4's plane SITL airframe 1033, so vehicle.toml's actuator map is the same everywhere: 2 rudder, 3 left flap, 4 motor, 5 left aileron, 6 right aileron, 7 elevator, 8 right flap
